subject: Vendor onboarding — MSA / Order Form redlines & portal gating
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@procureco.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial vendor onboarding - order form & redline questions

Hi team,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. I've attached our completed onboarding form (ProcureCo_Onboarding_Form.pdf) — several items surfaced that need clarification before we can finish portal registration and accept purchase orders. High level: 

- PO billing / remit address mismatch (finance requires specific remit fields for our AP system).
- We need clarity on the liability cap language in the MSA (Section 9) — our counsel flagged an open-ended indemnity carveout.
- EDI / ASN expectations: does Redwood require 850/810/856? Any required segment mapping?
- SFTP vs. vendor portal: do you offer SFTP credentials or only web portal entry?
- PO number format: our PO prefix is PC- + 8 digits; will Redwood accept that as the canonical PO ID?
- Acceptance/ack window: we typically need PO ack within 48h or we reject.

We'd like to lock these down this week to start provisioning in Ariba. Budgeted go-live target for ordering: 2027-09-15. Can someone confirm who will own each item and whether legal will do a quick redline pass?

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a 30m call if that's easier.

Best,
Alice Turner
Head of Procurement
ProcureCo, Inc.

Attachment: ProcureCo_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@procureco.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding - order form & redline questions

Alice — thanks for the thorough form and call notes. Quick breakdown below; attached is our annotated MSA (Redwood_MSA_annotated_v1.docx) with inline comments on the liability and indemnity items.

- PO billing / remit: Finance (jonas) will confirm exact remit fields and whether we can map PC- prefix to our PO_ID field. Action: jonas to send mapping by EOD 9/1.
- Liability cap / indemnity: tagging kimberly (Legal) to advise — see redline.
- EDI / ASN: our integrations team supports 850/810/856 via SFTP or API. Marissa will outline preferred flow and expected element mappings.
- SFTP vs Portal: we support both. For high-volume partners we provision SFTP; if ProcureCo prefers portal-only that's OK but will add manual steps for orders > 1k lines.
- PO format & ack window: we can accept PC- prefix; we'll set ack SLA to 48h to match your process.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Legal redline summary (kimberly) — by 9/1
- Finance remit mapping (jonas) — by 9/1
- Integration spec for EDI (marissa) — first draft 9/2
- Confirm SFTP cert workflow (security) — I'll loop security if SFTP is chosen

If helpful we can do a 30-min technical checkpoint tomorrow 9/1 10:00-10:30 PT.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_annotated_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@procureco.com>, mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding - order form & redline questions

Thanks — adding the procurement gating checklist so we don't miss portal fields (vendor-provisioning-checklist.csv). Key items for Ariba/Coupa provisioning: 

- Required fields: TaxID (EIN), Legal Entity name (must match W9), Remit Address (three-line), Default GL code (3 digits), PO prefix behavior (PC- accepted).
- EDI: confirm 850 for PO, 810 for invoice. We recommend setting up ASN/856 for shipments > 50 SKUs.
- PO acknowledgement window: 48 hours, automated ack preferred.
- Invoice routing: our system requires invoice_type and invoice_reference fields to match PO_ID exactly to auto-apply.
- Testing: sandbox EDI endpoint and SOAP/REST test harness will be available on 9/6; please confirm test contact.

ProcureCo requested a 9/15 go-live; given legal and EDI testing we'll aim for 9/15 if redlines are agreed and test window is used. If legal requires additional concessions it may slip to 9/22. Can you confirm the internal approval timeline on your side?

Marissa Cole
Director, Vendor Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor-provisioning-checklist.csv (text/csv)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial vendor onboarding - order form & redline questions

Hi Alice / team — legal has completed an initial pass. Summary of concessions and asks below (see attached OrderForm_v2.pdf for the specific proposed positions):

- Liability cap: willing to set a single-event cap at USD 500k and aggregate annual cap at USD 1.5M for ProcureCo accounts under this order form. We are not moving to an unlimited carveout for data processing claims.
- Indemnity: narrow to negligent acts and will require mutual indemnity for IP third-party claims; we added a limited exception for breach of confidentiality where personal data is involved.
- Data residency: we can commit to processing EU personal data in EU regions only if required (applies to EU customers). For ProcureCo (US) we will remain US processing unless requested otherwise.
- SFTP certs: we need the public SSH fingerprint and preferred SFTP username. If you prefer portal-only, confirm whether ProcureCo will accept manual ack for >1k-line orders.
- DocuSign: once finance confirms remit fields we'll prepare a clean Order Form for signature. Please review OrderForm_v2.pdf and provide any remaining redline items by EOD 9/3.

Next steps (legal / procurement):
- ProcureCo to confirm remit fields and SFTP fingerprint — Alice (owner) — by 9/3
- Redwood legal to issue final order form for signature after remit confirmation — kimberly — target 9/6
- Integration team to provision sandbox EDI endpoint on 9/6 — marissa

Thanks — looping in jonas for remit mapping and jonas please confirm GL mapping in your reply.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Corporate Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: OrderForm_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
